description: Source code for handling TRX firmware images, including functions for fixing, checking, and updating TRX headers on MTD devices.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes the CRC32 checksum in a TRX header on an MTD device.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Checks if a TRX image is valid and fits the target MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header in a specified region of an MTD device, recalculating CRC and length.
